official_title: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on ‘Proposal for a Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act) and amending certain union legislative acts’ (COM(2021) 206 final — 2021/106 (COD))
short_title: EESC opinion on the AI Act proposal

corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: The mandatory EESC opinion is a formal institutional contribution to procedure 2021/0106(COD).
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: EUR-Lex assigns this AI Act proposal opinion 2021/C 517/09, not 2021/C 517/08; the latter is the separate opinion on COM(2021) 205.
